conventions.axes: glTF: +Y up, right-handed, metres. web (x, y, z) = (UE X, UE Z, UE Y) x scale = (Blender X, Blender Z, -Blender Y) x scale.

scale.arena: real scale: 1 UU = 0.01 m, one board cell (200 UU) = 2 m
scale.desk: real-world size: 1 UU = 0.0001 m (the UE desk level is 100x real scale; the web build is not). Phone = 0.113 m long.

conventions.phoneFrame: Phone parts + keys share one pivot = LCD surface centre. Phone top -> +X, screen faces +Y, player's right -> +Z.
conventions.models: One mesh node per GLB (name = asset name) with identity transform: POSITION is float32, so mesh.geometry can be used directly (InstancedMesh etc.) and the pivot is the documented one. One primitive per material slot; material names = slot names (GLB material parameters are placeholders). EXT_meshopt_compression + KHR_mesh_quantization: register MeshoptDecoder on GLTFLoader. No tangents: use normalScale (1, -1) with the OpenGL normal maps (three derives tangents from UVs, exactly what GLTFLoader does for tangent-less glTF). COLOR_0 are linear MASKS, not tint colours (see colorAttributes/notes); do not enable vertexColors blindly.
conventions.textures: WebP. UVs follow glTF (v=0 at the top of the image): set texture.flipY = false. colorSpace srgb -> SRGBColorSpace, linear -> NoColorSpace. Normal maps are OpenGL convention. Tileable sets need RepeatWrapping.
conventions.audio: MP3 (LAME, Xing/LAME gapless header). duration/sampleRate/frames are the exact WAV source values. For loops set loopStart/loopEnd from the manifest; if the decoded AudioBuffer is longer than duration by about mp3PrimingSeconds (decoder did not trim encoder delay), offset both by mp3PrimingSeconds.
conventions.paths: Relative to the site base (no leading slash).

SM_CDCase.notes: Lies flat, front up, hinge on -X. MI_CDArt_A slot = 12x12 cm booklet under the clear lid, UV 0-1 (U -> +X, V -> +Y = art 'up'). Swap MI_CDArt_A/B/C per instance.

SM_CDPlayer.pivot: Bottom centre of the player body (cable stub extends to +X)
SM_CDPlayer.notes: Lid window centre at (0, 8, 290) UU; CD visible through smoked window. Buttons on the -Y edge, headphone cable on +X side.

SM_CRTMonitor.notes: Front (screen) faces -Y in Blender. MI_CRTScreen: slightly convex glass, UV 0-1 over the visible 31.2 x 24.4 cm opening (U -> +X right, V -> +Z up), centre at (0, -2070, 2500) UU. Emissive in UE.

SM_Desk.notes: Desk top slab only. UV0: top planar, 1 UV = 80 cm (texture tiles 2x along X, 1x along Y), sides unfolded at the same scale.

SM_DeskLamp.pivot: Centre of the round base on Z=0 (arms/head extend toward +X, so not the bbox centre)
SM_DeskLamp.notes: Shade points toward +X, 60 deg below horizontal. Shade mouth centre at (1794, 0, 3339) UU; bulb centre at (1539, 0, 3780) UU (put the spot light here).

SM_GelPen.notes: Lies along X (cap/tip toward +X), capped. Barrel and cap are translucent shells; ink tube inside uses MI_GelPen_Ink (glitter).

SM_LCDPixel.pivot: Bottom centre (Z 0 -> 1 UU), 1x1x1 UU; C++ scales to 3.4x3.4x3 UU
SM_LCDPixel.notes: Bevel 0.12 UU, 2 segments, weighted normals. Instanced 6080x.

SM_Phone_Body.pivot: Shared phone pivot = centre of the LCD surface (world origin); identity transform
SM_Phone_Body.notes: Same scale/orientation as faceplate, projected from the back. Deck/LCD recess floor flat at Z=-2 UU under the whole front (>= 410x290 UU). Antenna hump on back near top; power button on top edge (to X=+315 UU); charger port at bottom end.

SM_Phone_Faceplate.pivot: Shared phone pivot = centre of the LCD surface (world origin); identity transform
SM_Phone_Faceplate.notes: Front planar projection with side walls unfolded outward (low distortion). 1 UV unit = 1360 UU; v runs up the phone (+X), u toward the player's right. Whole faceplate fits in 0-1 (u ~0.25-0.75, v ~0.03-0.97); tileable textures can be scaled freely. Screen window 430 (Y) x 324 (X) UU with a soft chamfer; overlaps the bezel's outer edge (444 x 334) by ~7 UU/side so no seam shows. Key holes = key footprint + 4.5 UU clearance; Up/Down share one rocker hole.

SM_Phone_ScreenBezel.notes: Opening 404 (Y) x 280 (X) UU at its base, chamfered to ~416 x 294 at the top; spans Z 0..12 UU.

SM_Phone_ScreenGlass.notes: 0-1 across the glass (u toward player's right, v toward phone top).

SM_TopUpCard.notes: Lies flat. MI_TopUpCard (front + edges) UV 0-1 over the card face (U -> +X, V -> +Y); MI_TopUpCard_Back UV 0-1 mirrored so it reads correctly when flipped about Y.

SM_VirtualPet.pivot: Centre of the egg body on Z=0 (keyring extends toward +Y)
SM_VirtualPet.notes: Egg body 5 (Y) x 4 (X) x 1.5 cm, lies face up, top (keyring) toward +Y; keyring extends ~1.2 cm beyond. MI_VPet_LCD UV 0-1 over the 1.6 x 1.32 cm screen (U -> +X, V -> +Y).

SM_Window.pivot: Bottom centre of the frame on Z=0; Y=0 is the frame's mid-depth (wall plane). Sill protrudes to Y=-11 cm (interior side)
SM_Window.notes: Stands upright, interior side faces -Y. Sill at Z 0-3, frame to Z=100. MI_NightWindow pane (106 x 84 cm, set 1.5 cm behind the sashes) UV 0-1 across the whole opening (U -> +X, V -> +Z) so the view is continuous behind both sashes.

SM_ArenaTile.pivot: Top centre: top face at Z=0, tile spans Z -40..0
SM_ArenaTile.notes: Slot 0 Top = flat top face only, UV0 exactly 0..1 over it (bevel starts 3.5 UU in). Slot 1 Sides = bevels + sides + bottom, box UV (1 UV = 190 UU).

SM_Backdrop.notes: Radius 1 UU (0.01 m in Blender) - scale 400000 in engine for the 400 000 UU backdrop. 64 x 32 UV sphere, faces/normals point INWARD. UV0: U = longitude 0..1, V = 1 at the top pole -> 0.5 horizon -> 0 bottom pole. Slot Backdrop.

SM_BoardKerb.pivot: Bottom centre on Z=0 (X -100..100, Y -20..20, Z 0..50)
SM_BoardKerb.notes: Carved sandstone kerb segment for one perimeter cell. Outward (weathered, bullnosed, grooved) face toward UE -Y (modelled at Blender +Y; the export flips Y). Yaw it per board edge so -Y points away from the board. Profile: 9 UU bullnose on the outward top arris, carved 3.6 UU groove (1.2 deep) at Z 32-35 on the outward face, 1.5 UU round on the inner top arris, flat bottom. Weathering (erosion, pits, cracks, chips, face spalls) is periodic in X over the 200 UU length: the X=+-100 end caps are flat, identical outlines with identical custom normals, so segments butt seamlessly in a chain (import normals, don't recompute). Slot Stone. UV0 box projection 1 UV = 200 UU (the outward and inner faces run exactly 0..1 in U per segment, so a tiling texture continues across joints). Vertex colour (linear): R = cavity (cracks/pits/groove), G = edge wear + fresh chip faces, B = moss (up-facing + base band).

SM_Critter.notes: Golden scarab. Slot 0 Shell = elytra (with striae), pronotum, scutellum, head / toothed clypeus. Slot 1 Body = underside, legs (toothed front tibiae, 5-segment tarsi, claws), eyes, lamellate antennae. UV0 box projection (1 UV = 50 UU).

SM_FloatingRock_A.pivot: Plan centre, Z=0 at the grass rim level (cap domes above, rock hangs below)
SM_FloatingRock_A.notes: Floating islet: wide grass cap ~1260 UU across (1.5x the body radius), small overhanging lip, then an inverted-cone rock body ~609 deep with stalactite spires and 7 thin hanging roots (some forked) dangling from under the lip. Slots: 0 Rock (underside, spires, roots, boulders), 1 Grass (cap). UV0 box: Grass 1 UV = 400 UU, Rock 1 UV = 600 UU. Vertex colour as SM_Island (R cavity, G depth, B up-facing).

SM_FloatingRock_B.pivot: Plan centre, Z=0 at the grass rim level (cap domes above, rock hangs below)
SM_FloatingRock_B.notes: Floating islet: wide grass cap ~2400 UU across (1.5x the body radius), small overhanging lip, then an inverted-cone rock body ~1160 deep with stalactite spires and 10 thin hanging roots (some forked) dangling from under the lip. Slots: 0 Rock (underside, spires, roots, boulders), 1 Grass (cap). UV0 box: Grass 1 UV = 400 UU, Rock 1 UV = 600 UU. Vertex colour as SM_Island (R cavity, G depth, B up-facing).

SM_FloatingRock_C.pivot: Plan centre, Z=0 at the grass rim level (cap domes above, rock hangs below)
SM_FloatingRock_C.notes: Floating islet: wide grass cap ~4200 UU across (1.5x the body radius), small overhanging lip, then an inverted-cone rock body ~2030 deep with stalactite spires and 14 thin hanging roots (some forked) dangling from under the lip. Slots: 0 Rock (underside, spires, roots, boulders), 1 Grass (cap). UV0 box: Grass 1 UV = 400 UU, Rock 1 UV = 600 UU. Vertex colour as SM_Island (R cavity, G depth, B up-facing).

SM_FoodOrb.pivot: Centre of the fruit body (stem/leaf rise above it to ~+100 UU)
SM_FoodOrb.notes: Slot 0 Fruit: golden plum/apple, radius ~70, 5 soft lobes + a plum crease on +X. UV0 spherical (U = longitude 0..1 from +X, V = 1 top -> 0 bottom). Slot 1 Leaf: the leaf (two-sided shell, UV0 U 0..1 base->tip, V 0..1 across, midrib at V=0.5) and the stem (UV0 squeezed into U 0..0.02, i.e. the leaf texture's base edge).

SM_GrassTuft.pivot: Base centre on Z=0 (blade roots 1 UU below)
SM_GrassTuft.notes: 14 modelled V-folded blades (use a two-sided material). UV0 per blade: U 0..1 across the blade (0.5 = midrib), V 0 root -> 1 tip, so one blade texture (alpha/gradient) maps onto every blade. Slot Grass.

SM_Island.pivot: Board centre at origin, Z=0 = board top (tile tops)
SM_Island.notes: Square recess 4800 x 4800 centred on the origin, floor at Z=-40 (40 UU tiles sit flush at Z=0), recess walls Z=-40..0 (Earth). The board is a raised PLINTH: a dressed stone wall (slot Rock) 60 UU thick around the recess, X/Y +-2400..+-2460, flat seat at Z=0 (54 UU wide, for SM_BoardKerb: a 40 UU kerb centred 30 UU outside the board edge fits on it), 6 UU rounded outer arris, vertical face with a course joint at Z=-45, chamfered footing course (face +4.5 UU) down to the ground ring at Z=-120 (+-2468). Then a flat gravel/dirt APRON (slot Earth, Z -120..-122) to ~310 UU from the plinth face (ragged edge +-35 UU, i.e. to |x|,|y| ~ 2770), then the GRASS rim (slot Grass): rises gently ~10 UU, rolls over into the soil lip (Earth) at ~Z=-165, lip 3760 +- 160 from the centre (~1360 on the axes). Then the rocky underside (Rock) with strata ledges + fluting down to ~Z=-3600 plus 23 hanging spires and 5 low boulder clusters on the rim. UV0 box projection: Grass/Earth 1 UV = 400 UU, Rock 1 UV = 600 UU. Vertex colour (linear): R = cavity, G = depth below the top (0 at Z=0 -> 1 at Z=-3500), B = up-facing mask (moss/grass creep).

SM_NeonBlock.notes: Slot 0 Body = rounded block (edge radius 12, plan corner radius 14). Slot 1 Edge = 3 UU wide, 1.2 UU proud band on the top edge loop + the 4 vertical corner edges (emissive). Box UV on Body (1 UV = 190 UU).

SM_Ruin_A.notes: Weathered ashlar block on a plinth course, slanted fractured top. Slot Stone. UV0 box projection, 1 UV = 200 UU (one cell); use triplanar/world-aligned if seams show. Vertex colour (linear): R = cavity (cracks/pits), G = edge wear (convexity), B = moss mask (up-facing, noise).

SM_Ruin_B.notes: Fluted column stump (18 flutes) on a square plinth with a torus moulding, broken jagged top. Slot Stone. UV0 box projection, 1 UV = 200 UU (one cell); use triplanar/world-aligned if seams show. Vertex colour (linear): R = cavity (cracks/pits), G = edge wear (convexity), B = moss mask (up-facing, noise).

SM_Ruin_C.notes: Collapsed masonry: two lower blocks, a skewed upper course and a capstone, with open joints between stones. Slot Stone. UV0 box projection, 1 UV = 200 UU (one cell); use triplanar/world-aligned if seams show. Vertex colour (linear): R = cavity (cracks/pits), G = edge wear (convexity), B = moss mask (up-facing, noise).

SM_SnakeBody.pivot: Start of tube at origin, axis +X, X 0..100
SM_SnakeBody.notes: underside (V=0/1 at the belly centre line) 24 radial x 8 length segments, open ends, shared verts at the V seam (UV split only, so normals are continuous). UV0: U = X/100 (0..1 along length), V = 0 at the belly centre -> 0.25 on the Blender +Y side (= UE -Y) -> 0.5 back -> 0.75 -> 1 belly. Cross-section: top & sides radius 50, belly a superellipse 45 deep (10% flatter). Slot Skin.

SM_SnakeHead.pivot: Neck centre at origin; head faces +X; the neck ring (X -8..0) matches the body tube section (radius 50, flat belly) and is tucked 3% inside it behind X=0.
SM_SnakeHead.notes: Slots: 0 Skin, 1 Eyes (two UV spheres, UV0 planar from the front: iris/pupil centred at UV 0.5,0.5, V up), 2 Mouth (the lip-seam groove from the mouth corner round the snout). UV0 on Skin = unwrap: U = arc length along the head from X=0 (1 UV = 100 UU, like SM_SnakeBody), V = 0.5 on the top centre line, arc around / neck circumference, seam on the underside (V 0/1 at the neck matches the body). UV1 'UVPlan' = top-down planar 0..1 over the head (large head scutes). Vertex colour (linear): R = head-plate mask (top), G = belly mask, B = cavity.

SM_SnakeTongue.notes: Slot Tongue. Horizontal fork (tines spread in +-Y). UV U along length.

SM_Voxel.notes: Slot Voxel. Box UV, each face 0..1.

SM_VoxelHead.notes: 100 UU cube with SM_Voxel's 7 UU / 3-segment bevel. Two square eye notches 22 x 22 UU, 12 UU deep, in the top face (+Z) toward +X: centres X=+22, Y=+-19, rims softened with a 1.4 UU bevel. Slot Voxel. Box UV, each face 0..1. Vertex colour R = 1 inside the notches (optional darker/emissive eye tint), else 0.
